unmet: Recording needs {fact}, which is not so.
notice_sent: The recording notice has been given.
notice_type: This device types the recording notice into the empty chat field.
notice_frame: The field is in use, so the notice goes on the camera picture.
notice_wait: Waiting for a way to give the recording notice.
notice_stop: No way to give the notice was found in time, so recording stops.
